capabilities: Back up the vault on startup, quit, or at a set interval
Include or exclude folders and files using wildcard patterns
Back up through external archivers such as 7-Zip, WinRAR, or Bandizip
Customize the backup output path and file naming
Create a specific backup file from the command palette or sidebar
extras: The README warns that interval backups consume CPU and disk I/O and recommends a frequency of at least 10 minutes; external archiver backup is marked experimental for large vaults. Backups are local only, not cloud sync. The author asks for donations via buy-me-a-coffee.
problem: Obsidian keeps notes as plain files but has no built-in scheduled or automatic local backup beyond File recovery snapshots, so users must back up the vault manually or with outside tools.
